name: Kamishima Souta
source:
A second-year student at Seirei Academy. Perverted and proactive, but surprisingly righteous and deeply compassionate.

Through a twist of fate, awakens to abilities and magic rooted in "Lust," one of the Seven Great Demon Lineages, leaving him troubled by an even greater surge of sexual desire. At the academy, he belongs to both the Ramen Club and the Speech Club. His parents run a ramen shop, meaning their daily schedules are completely out of sync. Because of this, he is capable of doing general housework if needed, but usually skips it out of laziness.

His favorite type of ramen is back-fat (seabura) style.

Favorite things: Boobs (everyone's so different and that's good), ramen, dog
Disliked things: Nudes that doesn't show nipples

[Translated from the [url=https://whirlpool.co.jp/sprinkle/character/chara5.php#chara-main]official website[/url]]
